title: Research design under a restricted budget
assignment: Develop a small research proposal. generative AI may assist wording and suggest designs; the student verifies references and retains responsibility for the final proposal. Independent checkpoints use an unfamiliar problem.
ai_permissions: Develop a small research proposal. generative AI may assist wording and suggest designs; the student verifies references and retains responsibility for the final proposal. Independent checkpoints use an unfamiliar problem.
budget_scope: Additional checkpoint work; existing product marking excluded

requirements.description: Select and justify a design appropriate to a question.
distinguish the inference supported by the design from a causal overclaim. One individual demonstration of each is mandatory.

checkpoints.name: Design choice response
checkpoints.prompt: D: A college compares volunteers using an AI tutor with non-volunteers and claims the tutor caused higher achievement. Choose a stronger feasible design, identify the sampling issue and rewrite the conclusion within the evidence limits. Candidate: Design choice response.
checkpoints.conditions: E1 Select and justify a design appropriate to a question. E2 identify a sampling limitation. E3 distinguish the inference supported by the design from a causal overclaim. One individual demonstration of each is mandatory.
checkpoints.ai_permissions: Develop a small research proposal. generative AI may assist wording and suggest designs; the student verifies references and retains responsibility for the final proposal. Independent checkpoints use an unfamiliar problem.
checkpoints.mapping_rationale: The software may propose an explicit budget change or new candidates. It must not silently remove E3 or substitute self-report for the independent demonstration.

approval.reviewer: Original development fixture; expert review pending

expected_narrative: No combination fits the 100-minute teacher time limit. D alone is the cheapest complete combination at 110 minutes, S = 15. The shortfall is 10 minutes. Increasing the budget to 110 makes D feasible. Removing the teacher limit must not conceal the fact that A + B + C uses 180 minutes.
